# Jellyfish — AI Short Drama Studio

English · 简体中文 · 日本語

A production workspace for AI short dramas. Divide a chapter into scenes, prepare visual references and generate candidate frames on a storyboard canvas. The interface supports Chinese (default) and English. [Quick start](#-docker-compose) · [Local development](docs/development/guides/local-development.md) ## 📷 Screenshots **How this shot was made**　The storyboard for a seaside station scene connects the shot description and three visual references to an image model. The creator picked a frame from its outputs for a slow push-in. [Selected first frame](site/static/images/docs/labs/letter-frame.jpg) · [▶ 3-second camera test (local demo)](site/static/images/sea-letter/letter-push-in.mp4)

## ✨ Core Value - Trace each scene back to the passage it adapts. - Reuse the same character, location and prop references across shots. - Inspect the inputs and results of a generation run before choosing a candidate. ## ✨ Core Capabilities ### 1. AI script understanding and storyboard breakdown Save the chapter text, mark scene boundaries, then generate and edit a storyboard for a selected scene. ### 2. Shot preparation and confirmation workflow Chapter text → scene division → reference selection → storyboard canvas → precheck → candidate review. ### 3. Asset consistency and reuse Link characters, locations, props and costumes to project assets. Choose the reference images needed for each scene. ### 4. Shot-level image and video orchestration On the canvas, connect shot descriptions and references to a model card, check its inputs and review the generated media. ### 5. Unified async task center Track text, image and video jobs, inspect failures and cancel eligible tasks. ### 6. Model, prompt, and generation infrastructure Configure providers and default models, manage prompt templates and access the backend through its OpenAPI contract. ## 🚀 Feature Overview ### Project and chapter management Create a project, save chapter text and reopen earlier scene divisions. ### AI script processing Use the text lab to explore alternate dialogue, actions and shot descriptions. ### Shot preparation workflow Review the source passage alongside the scene references and refine each shot description. ### Asset and entity management Maintain project assets and choose which reference images a scene uses. ### Shot generation workspace Edit prompts and model parameters, run a precheck and preview candidate outputs. ### Task center Monitor progress and open a task to inspect its result. ### Model and prompt infrastructure Choose defaults for different generation tasks and maintain reusable prompt templates. ### File and media management Preview uploaded and generated media and reuse them as references. ## 🎯 Use Cases - Short-drama teams preparing storyboards and reviewing candidate frames together. - Independent creators trying different shots for the same scene. - Education, brand and e-commerce teams developing scripts into short videos. ## 🔁 Frontend OpenAPI client and type generation With the API serving the current code at `http://127.0.0.1:8000`, run the following from the repository root to refresh `front/openapi.json` and `front/src/services/generated/`. ```bash pnpm --dir front run openapi:update ``` ## 🐳 Docker Compose ### Ports - Frontend: `http://localhost:7788` - API: `http://localhost:8000` (Swagger UI: `/docs`) - MySQL: `localhost:${MYSQL_PORT:-3306}` - RustFS: `http://localhost:${RUSTFS_PORT:-9000}` ### Start From the repository root, create the environment file on first setup and start the services. ```bash cp deploy/compose/.env.example deploy/compose/.env docker compose --env-file deploy/compose/.env -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up --build ``` Once the frontend opens, [create your first project](site/content/docs/guide/first-project.md). Before generating media, [configure a model](site/content/docs/getting-started/model-setup.md). ## 🧑‍💻 Local Development Follow the [local development guide](docs/development/guides/local-development.md) to start the API, task worker and Vite frontend. See the [developer documentation](docs/development/README.md) for architecture and standards, or the [site guide](site/README.md) to work on the website. ## 📄 License This project is licensed under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). ## 💬 Community & Feedback - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Forget-C/Jellyfish/issues)

# Jellyfish — AI 短剧工作台

English · 简体中文 · 日本語

面向 AI 短剧创作的制作工作台。从章节原文划分场次，准备视觉参考，再到分镜画布生成候选画面。界面支持中文和英文，默认中文。 [快速启动](#-docker-compose) · [本地开发](development/guides/local-development.md) ## 📷 项目截图 **这一镜是怎样生成的**　《雾海来信》的分镜画布把镜头描述和人物、站台、旧信封三张参考图接入图片模型。创作者从候选画面中选定首帧，试拍了一段慢推镜。 [查看选定首帧](../site/static/images/docs/labs/letter-frame.jpg) · [▶ 观看 3 秒试拍（本地演示）](../site/static/images/sea-letter/letter-push-in.mp4)

## ✨ 核心价值 - 每个场次都能对照它改编的原文片段。 - 跨镜头复用角色、场所和道具参考，保持视觉一致。 - 选择候选画面前，可以核对生成所用的输入和结果。 ## ✨ 核心能力 ### 1. AI 剧本理解与分镜拆解 保存章节原文，标记场次边界，再为选定场次生成并编辑分镜。 ### 2. 镜头准备与确认流程 章节原文 → 场次划分 → 选用参考 → 分镜画布 → 生成预检 → 查看候选画面。 ### 3. 资产一致性与复用 将角色、场所、道具和服装与项目资产关联，为每个场次选用所需参考图。 ### 4. 镜头级图像与视频生成 在画布中把镜头描述和参考素材接入模型卡，预检输入并查看生成的图像或视频。 ### 5. 统一异步任务中心 跟踪文本、图像和视频任务，查看失败原因，取消支持取消的任务。 ### 6. 模型、提示词与生成服务 配置服务商和默认模型，管理提示词模板，通过 OpenAPI 接口访问后端。 ## 🚀 功能概览 ### 项目与章节管理 创建项目，保存章节原文，查看历史划分方案。 ### AI 剧本处理 在文本实验室中试写对白、角色动作和镜头描述。 ### 镜头准备流程 对照原文和场次参考，逐镜调整描述。 ### 资产与实体管理 维护项目资产，选择场次实际采用的参考图。 ### 镜头生成工作区 编辑提示词和模型参数，执行预检，预览候选结果。 ### 任务中心 查看执行进度，打开任务核对结果。 ### 模型与提示词管理 为不同生成任务选择默认模型，维护可复用的提示词模板。 ### 文件与媒体管理 预览上传文件和生成媒体，并将其用作参考素材。 ## 🎯 适用场景 - 短剧团队协作准备分镜、评审候选画面。 - 独立创作者为同一场戏尝试不同的镜头表达。 - 教育、品牌和电商团队把脚本制作成短视频。 ## 🔁 前端 OpenAPI 客户端与类型生成 在 `http://127.0.0.1:8000` 启动当前版本的后端后，从仓库根目录运行以下命令，更新 `front/openapi.json` 和 `front/src/services/generated/`。 ```bash pnpm --dir front run openapi:update ``` ## 🐳 Docker Compose ### 端口 - 前端: `http://localhost:7788` - API: `http://localhost:8000` (Swagger UI: `/docs`) - MySQL: `localhost:${MYSQL_PORT:-3306}` - RustFS: `http://localhost:${RUSTFS_PORT:-9000}` ### 启动 首次配置时，在仓库根目录创建环境文件，然后启动服务。 ```bash cp deploy/compose/.env.example deploy/compose/.env docker compose --env-file deploy/compose/.env -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up --build ``` 打开前端后，先[创建第一个项目](../site/content/docs/guide/first-project.md)。生成媒体前，请先[配置模型](../site/content/docs/getting-started/model-setup.md)。 ## 🧑‍💻 本地开发 参照[本地开发指南](development/guides/local-development.md)启动 API、任务工作进程和 Vite 前端。架构与规范见[开发文档](development/README.md)，官网维护见[站点指南](../site/README.md)。 ## 📄 许可证 本项目使用 [Apache-2.0](../LICENSE) 许可证。 ## 💬 社区与反馈 - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Forget-C/Jellyfish/issues)
